facts_cn: HNSW 全称 Hierarchical Navigable Small World，是一种基于图结构的近似最近邻搜索算法。
该算法通过多层可导航小世界图组织向量数据，上层节点稀疏、下层节点稠密。
检索时从最上层开始贪婪搜索，逐层下降，在底层完成细粒度近邻查找。
HNSW 在召回率和查询速度之间取得了很好的平衡，被众多向量数据库采用。
facts_en: HNSW stands for Hierarchical Navigable Small World, an approximate nearest neighbor search algorithm based on graph structures.
It organizes vector data into a multi-layer navigable small world graph, where upper layers are sparse and lower layers are dense.
During search it greedily traverses from the top layer downward, finishing with fine-grained neighbor lookup at the bottom.
HNSW achieves a good trade-off between recall and query speed, and is adopted by many vector databases.
t01.query_cn: HNSW 索引是如何组织向量并完成近邻搜索的？

facts_cn: 向量数据库专门存储高维向量，并提供高效的相似度检索能力。
常见的相似度度量包括欧氏距离、余弦相似度和内积。
向量数据库通常为向量列建立 HNSW 或 IVF 等近似索引以加速查询。
许多现代数据库将向量检索与全文检索、标量过滤结合，支持混合查询。
facts_en: Vector databases are designed to store high-dimensional vectors and provide efficient similarity search.
Common similarity metrics include Euclidean distance, cosine similarity, and inner product.
Vector databases usually build approximate indexes such as HNSW or IVF on vector columns to accelerate queries.
Many modern databases combine vector search with full-text search and scalar filtering to support hybrid queries.
t02.query_en: How do vector databases combine vector search with full-text search?

facts_cn: IK 分词器是面向中文文本的常用分词组件，支持细粒度和智能两种切分模式。
智能模式会尽量切分出更长的词语，使分词结果更接近自然语义。
中文全文检索通常先对文本分词，再构建倒排索引。
在 seekdb 中可以用 WITH PARSER ik 为全文索引指定 IK 分词器。
facts_en: The IK tokenizer is a popular tokenization component for Chinese text, supporting fine-grained and smart segmentation modes.
Smart mode prefers longer words so that the segmentation result is closer to natural semantics.
Chinese full-text search usually tokenizes the text first and then builds an inverted index.
In seekdb, WITH PARSER ik specifies the IK tokenizer for a full-text index.
t03.query_cn: IK 分词器的智能模式有什么特点，在 seekdb 中怎么配置？

facts_cn: WebGPU 是新一代浏览器图形与计算 API，可以直接访问 GPU 的并行计算能力。
与 WebGL 相比，WebGPU 提供了更底层的控制能力和更低的驱动开销。
在浏览器中运行机器学习推理时，WebGPU 通常比 WASM 更快。
使用前需要通过 navigator.gpu 检测设备是否支持，并请求适配器。
facts_en: WebGPU is a next-generation browser graphics and compute API that gives direct access to GPU parallel computing.
Compared with WebGL, WebGPU offers lower-level control and reduced driver overhead.
When running machine learning inference in the browser, WebGPU is usually faster than WASM.
Before use, check support via navigator.gpu and request an adapter.
t04.query_cn: WebGPU 相比 WASM 在浏览器端推理上有什么优势？

facts_cn: WebAssembly 简称 WASM，是一种可在浏览器中高效执行的二进制指令格式。
WASM 代码在沙箱中运行，具备良好的安全隔离和跨平台能力。
许多机器学习框架通过将 C++ 代码编译为 WASM 来支持浏览器端推理。
WASM 的兼容性极好，几乎在所有现代浏览器中都可以运行。
facts_en: WebAssembly, or WASM for short, is a binary instruction format that executes efficiently in browsers.
WASM code runs inside a sandbox, providing good security isolation and cross-platform capability.
Many machine learning frameworks compile C++ code to WASM to support in-browser inference.
WASM has excellent compatibility and runs in almost all modern browsers.
t05.query_en: Why is WebAssembly widely used as a fallback for browser inference?

facts_cn: INT8 量化把模型权重从 32 位浮点数压缩为 8 位整数，可以大幅缩小模型体积。
动态量化在推理时根据激活值范围换算比例因子，实现简单且效果好。
量化通常会带来轻微的精度损失，但检索质量往往几乎不受影响。
量化后的模型在内存占用和加载速度上都有明显优势。
facts_en: INT8 quantization compresses model weights from 32-bit floats to 8-bit integers, greatly reducing model size.
Dynamic quantization computes scale factors from activation ranges at inference time, which is simple and effective.
Quantization usually introduces slight precision loss, but retrieval quality is often barely affected.
Quantized models have clear advantages in memory footprint and loading speed.
t06.query_cn: INT8 动态量化为什么能缩小模型体积且几乎不影响检索质量？

facts_cn: 注意力机制让模型在处理每个词时能够参考输入序列中的其他词。
自注意力通过查询、键、值三个矩阵计算词与词之间的相关性权重。
多头注意力把表示空间划分为多个子空间，并行捕捉不同的依赖关系。
Transformer 架构完全基于注意力机制，摒弃了传统的循环结构。
facts_en: The attention mechanism lets the model reference other tokens in the input sequence when processing each token.
Self-attention computes relevance weights between tokens through query, key, and value matrices.
Multi-head attention splits the representation space into multiple subspaces to capture different dependencies in parallel.
The Transformer architecture is entirely based on attention and abandons traditional recurrent structures.
t07.query_en: How does multi-head self-attention work in Transformers?

facts_cn: RAG 在生成回答之前先检索相关文档，把检索结果作为上下文提供给大模型。
这种方法可以显著减少大模型产生幻觉的概率。
检索质量直接决定了 RAG 系统的回答质量上限。
向量检索与全文检索的混合策略常用于提升召回效果。
facts_en: RAG retrieves relevant documents before generation and feeds the results to the large model as context.
This approach can significantly reduce the probability of hallucinations from large models.
Retrieval quality directly determines the upper bound of answer quality in a RAG system.
Hybrid strategies combining vector and full-text search are often used to improve recall.
t08.query_cn: RAG 为什么能减少大模型的幻觉问题？

facts_cn: seekdb 是 OceanBase 推出的 AI 原生数据库，支持向量、全文和标量数据的统一存储。
seekdb 兼容 MySQL 协议，支持 VECTOR 列类型和 HNSW 向量索引。
全文检索可以使用 IK 分词器处理中文文本。
在一条 SQL 中同时使用 MATCH 与向量距离排序即可完成混合检索。
facts_en: seekdb is an AI-native database from OceanBase that stores vector, full-text, and scalar data in one system.
seekdb is MySQL-compatible and supports the VECTOR column type and HNSW vector indexes.
Full-text search can use the IK tokenizer for Chinese text.
Hybrid search can be done in a single SQL statement combining MATCH with vector distance ordering.
t09.query_cn: seekdb 如何用一条 SQL 完成向量与全文的混合检索？

facts_cn: 倒排索引记录每个词出现在哪些文档中，是全文搜索引擎的核心数据结构。
建立倒排索引前通常需要分词，把文档切分成独立的词项。
查询时根据词项直接定位候选文档，避免了逐篇扫描。
倒排索引配合跳表可以高效处理多词项的合并操作。
facts_en: An inverted index records which documents each term appears in, and is the core data structure of full-text search engines.
Tokenization is usually needed before building an inverted index to split documents into terms.
Queries locate candidate documents directly by term, avoiding a full scan of every document.
With skip lists, inverted indexes efficiently handle merge operations across multiple terms.
t10.query_en: What is an inverted index and why does it speed up full-text search?
